title: EgradxAccessTokenClaims
description: Payload of an EGRADX access token. Signed RS256 by the issuer; verifiers check signature, iss and exp. Issued by egradx-auth (Java: com.egradx.auth.token.EgradxTokenIssuer); read by egradx-web-security (com.egradx.webservice.security.EgradxJwtTokenUtil). Guest tokens (userType Guest) use a separate mapping and are not described here.

sub.description: The user's id. Exposed to application code as userId.

iat.description: Issued at, seconds since the epoch.

exp.description: Expires at, seconds since the epoch.

sid.description: The session's id (egradx_session): the same for every access token of one sign-in, across refreshes. A verifier on the SDK refuses the token once that session has ended.

organizationId.description: The organization the session acts in. Omitted, not null, when there is none.

roleId.description: The caller's role in organizationId. Omitted when there is none.

platformAccess.description: Accepted by verifiers (roles become ROLE_<role> authorities); not issued by egradx-auth 1.0.0, which carries no roles in tokens and resolves permissions from its database on each request.

scope.description: Comma-delimited scopes, SCOPE_<scope> authorities. Accepted by verifiers; not issued by egradx-auth 1.0.0.

claims.description: Free-form extra claims. Accepted by verifiers; not issued by egradx-auth 1.0.0.
